title: Expected number of satisfied linear constraints
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set and let $\mathcal{C}$ be a finite multiset of constraints, each requiring the sum in $\mathbb{F}_2$ of three distinct variables to equal a specified right-hand side in $\mathbb{F}_2$. Under a uniformly random assignment of elements of $\mathbb{F}_2$ to $V$, the expected number of satisfied constraints in $\mathcal{C}$ is $|\mathcal{C}|/2$.
hypotheses_covered: The constraints form a finite multiset
Each constraint has an injective scope of three variables
Each constraint specifies a right-hand side in $\mathbb{F}_2$
